text:
**Deforestation cannot be confirmed.** Satellite data supports approximately 0.7 ha of tree-cover loss on the asset in 2023, or 1.2% of its area. The entire loss area was mapped as forest in the 2020 reference; the 2021 national map classified 0.4 ha as planted eucalyptus and 0.3 ha as outside mapped forest.

Tree-cover loss can include plantation harvesting or other stand replacement, so it does not by itself establish deforestation or a change in land use. The cause is unknown.
